theme: An open Saturday before a full Sunday.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan — an open Saturday with the girls in St. Pete. Two holiday bookings have been waiting, and tomorrow brings the Sunday review and the island annual meeting.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 board item has been open since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and it sells out; a refundable hold costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and the Oct 15 book-by has now passed. Six people across three holiday weeks is the year's thinnest inventory, and the domestic-vs-international call is still open.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike, 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Several board items have slipped three-plus weeks — the term-life quotes, the Pathfinder drive, the Portland order — and tomorrow's 15-minute review is where they get triaged, killed, or re-dated.

needsAttention.title: Island annual meeting, 5 PM
needsAttention.detail: The DIRA & DIBA annual meeting is on Zoom tomorrow evening; the materials were emailed separately, so a skim beforehand is worth it.

flagged.title: KPMG Managing Director alert
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert surfaced a KPMG US Managing Director role, marked important in your inbox.

flagged.title: IFAC connection request
flagged.detail: Bruce from IFAC (education & member monitoring) sent a LinkedIn connection request still awaiting a response.

flagged.title: Dropbox storage warning
flagged.detail: Dropbox calls this a final reminder before files are removed on Oct 25 for being over the storage limit.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promotions — FT, Monocle, the St. Pete and Midcoast locals, and a stack of Halloween sales.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its peak, so a slow-roasted pumpkin soup makes the most of the season.

acts.line: Nothing scheduled — a slow start with the girls in St. Pete.
The afternoon is open; the Christmas rental and December trip are the two things that have been waiting on it.
A quiet evening ahead of a full Sunday — the 9 AM review with Mike and the 5 PM annual meeting.
